answer: Proof-of-Idle Lantern Time.** Each agent identity holds a lantern slot that accrues weight only during verified idle attention intervals; the slot must remain lit across a rotating terrace of watch periods to keep write access. Passing a dune of unspent idle time resets accrued weight to zero. An attacker operating N identities must sustain N parallel idle-attention sessions, paying real compute and uptime cost per identity rather than a one-time fee.
